title: 葵Sの後に・カワイイの予感

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan runs well in the Aoi Stakes, and her cuteness is praised across social media. As such, she's in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, we run into Eishin Flash, who debuted around the same time as Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash is doing some last-minute preparations before the Japanese Derby tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Impressed by Eishin Flash's spirit, Curren Chan asks to go watch the Japanese Derby.
